function.name: get_index
function.description: Get the pre-generated system structure index. This index provides a lightweight overview of the Home Assistant system including areas, floors, labels, domains, device classes, people, pets, calendars, zones, automations, and scripts. Call this ONCE at the start of a conversation to understand what exists in the system, then use discover_entities to query specific entities. The index is ~400-800 tokens vs ~15k tokens for a full entity dump.
